workshoptitle: Oracle Linux Virtualization Manager (OLVM) on OCI - Beginner

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Workshop audience, prerequisites, sequencing rules, and expected outcomes.

tutorials.title: Get Started
tutorials.description: Sign in to OCI and confirm access to the tenancy and compartment used for this workshop.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Build E5 OCI Infrastructure with Ansible
tutorials.description: Use a bootstrap instance and Ansible to build the E5 OCI environment when one has not already been provided.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Deploy OLVM Engine
tutorials.description: Connect to the manager with SSH, install OLVM Engine, and validate portal access.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Configure KVM Cluster
tutorials.description: Add both KVM hosts to the default cluster and wait for them to reach Up status.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Set Up Networking, Storage, and VM
tutorials.description: Create the VM network, add storage, import the template, and validate a test VM.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Deploy Multi Tier Application
tutorials.description: Import the application OVAs, start the VMs, and verify the Employee Directory application.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Perform Live Migration
tutorials.description: Migrate a running virtual machine between hosts and validate continuity without interrupting Lab 5.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Optional Luna OLVM Administration
tutorials.description: Complete a separate Luna session covering OLVM deployment, migration, backup, monitoring, snapshots, and users and roles. Allow 6-8 hours; requires the direct Luna lab link.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Luna OLVM Administration Quiz
tutorials.description: Answer 100 scored questions from Lab 7, with ten questions per task, explanations, and an 80% passing score.

tutorials.title: Lab 9: OLVM Administration Quiz
tutorials.description: Review OLVM administration with 100 scored questions, ten per topic, explanations, and an 80% passing score.

tutorials.title: Lab 10: OLVM Instructor-Led Training Quiz
tutorials.description: Use alongside Lab 7: 100 scored OLVM questions, ten per task, with discussion explanations and an 80% passing score.

tutorials.title: Lab 11: OLVM Self-Study Quiz Bank
tutorials.description: Separate 500-question study bank across seven weighted objective areas, with explanations, module badges, and a 38-subtopic coverage guide.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Troubleshooting resources and directions for getting assistance during the workshop.
